```plato

//==
// # Named layer 1 — the primitive view
//
// Each binding fixes the point type and the primitive, and carries the
// dimensional capabilities every such shape can honor: PointSet for the free
// Bounds and VertexCentroid, Bounded for the box itself, Deformable for the
// point mapping that Transform is then derived from. The triangle and quad
// bindings add IMesh, which the segment bindings cannot: a set of segments
// has no interior to triangulate.
//
// The line primitive is Line2D / Line3D, not InfiniteLine2D / InfiniteLine3D:
// a line set stores bounded segments, while InfiniteLine*D is an infinite line.

// Bounded segments in space over their own endpoints: wireframes, edge
// overlays, sampled space curves.
interface ISegmentGeometry3D
    inherits IGeometry3D, IPrimitiveGeometry<Point3D, Line3D>, IPointSet3D, IBounded3D, IDeformable3D
{ }
```
